summary: This document updates the IANA registries for MPLS Label Switched Path (LSP) Ping defined in RFC 8029 and RFC 8611. For the TLV and sub-TLV registries, the registration procedure formerly called Private Use is changed to First Come First Served. It also clarifies how responses are sent when an unknown or erroneous code point is seen, and aligns the wording with RFC 8126.

eli5.summary: A club keeps a list of codes people can claim. This document changes the rule for one list from keeping some codes secret for private use to letting anyone claim an unused code by asking first.
